# KGIL Fintech Solutions Private Limited — Full Site Content

> Source: https://kgilfintech.com
> Entity: KGIL Fintech Solutions Private Limited (CIN U70200PN2024PTC231463)
> Purpose: corporate website for the legal entity. Product support lives on the
> brand websites, swipeloan.in and bestscore.in.

---

## 1. Company overview

KGIL Fintech Solutions Private Limited is the fintech arm of KGIL Group, a diversified
Indian group with interests in infrastructure, fintech and securities. The company runs the
group's consumer credit business through two brands: Swipeloan and BestScore.

This website represents the legal entity. It is where vendors, lending partners and
compliance teams can confirm who the company is, where it is registered and how to reach it
officially. For product help, each brand has its own website and support team.

Positioning statement: "Credit that people can actually read." The company builds digital
products that help Indian consumers check their credit, watch it change, and find borrowing
options that fit.

Guiding idea: credit should be something you understand, not something that happens to you.

At a glance:

- Registered office: Pune, Maharashtra, India
- Consumer brands: 2 — Swipeloan and BestScore
- Lending model: partner-led. Banks and NBFCs lend; KGIL Fintech does not.

## 2. What the company builds

### Credit marketplace — through Swipeloan

Compare loan offers from partner banks and NBFCs side by side, then apply for the one that
fits, without visiting a branch.

### Credit score monitoring — through BestScore

A personalised view of your credit score, how it moves over time, and plain-language
explanations of what is driving it.

### Android app and web — across both brands

Both platforms run as an Android app and in the browser, so people can check their credit
and apply from the device they already use.

## 3. How lending works on the platform

Swipeloan is a marketplace. Loans are sanctioned and disbursed by registered lending
partners, under their own terms. KGIL Fintech Solutions Private Limited is not the lender.

1. Sign up — Create an account with your phone number and basic details.
2. Verify identity — Complete KYC with Aadhaar and PAN through our verification partner.
3. Compare offers — See offers you are eligible for from partner banks and NBFCs.
4. Partner disburses — The lender you choose completes the sanction and disburses the loan.

Important: loan terms, interest rates and repayment conditions are set by the lending
partner and shown to you before you accept. Always read the lender's key fact statement
before signing.

## 4. Brands

### Swipeloan — swipeloan.in

A credit marketplace that helps people compare and access loan offers from partner lenders.

- Offers from registered banks and NBFCs in one place
- Fully digital application and KYC
- Android app and web

### BestScore — bestscore.in

A personalised credit score monitoring platform that shows where you stand and why.

- Score tracking over time
- Insights on the factors behind your score
- Android app and web

Both brands are owned and operated by KGIL Fintech Solutions Private Limited.

## 5. Data and privacy

The company collects only what is needed to provide its services, with user consent, under
the Information Technology Act, 2000 and the Information Technology (Reasonable Security
Practices and Procedures and Sensitive Personal Data or Information) Rules, 2011 ("SPDI
Rules").

- Consent first — Access to device data such as SMS, files or contacts is requested only
  when a service needs it.
- Shared on need-to-know — Data goes only to the business partners who fulfil the service
  you asked for.
- Secured storage — Servers sit behind a firewall, with password-protected and strictly
  limited access.
- We never sell your data — Personal information is not sold or rented to advertisers or any
  third party.

Full policy: https://kgilfintech.com/privacy-policy/

## 6. Vision, mission and values

Vision: to make credit simple, transparent and accessible for every Indian consumer.

Mission: to provide clear, reliable digital tools that help people check, monitor and improve
their credit health, and find credit options that suit them.

Values: transparency; customer trust; regulatory compliance; responsible use of data.

## 8. Frequently asked questions

Q: Does KGIL Fintech lend money directly?
A: Loans shown on Swipeloan are sanctioned and disbursed by our lending partners — registered
banks and NBFCs. We facilitate the comparison and application; the lender sets and applies
its own terms.

Q: How are Swipeloan and BestScore related to this company?
A: Both are brands owned and operated by KGIL Fintech Solutions Private Limited, the fintech
subsidiary of KGIL Group.

Q: Where do I get help with my app account or loan?
A: Use the support options on swipeloan.in or bestscore.in, or inside the app. For questions
about a loan itself, you can also contact the lending partner named in your loan documents.

Q: How do I raise a complaint about my personal data?
A: Write to our Grievance Officer, Kunika Modi, at grievance@swipeloan.in or call
+91 90280 65621. Include your registered phone number and details of the issue so it can be
resolved within the timelines set under the IT Act, 2000.

Q: How can my company become a partner or vendor?
A: Email info@swipeloan.in with your company details and the service you offer. Our team will
respond with next steps and any documents needed for onboarding.

Q: How do I stop promotional messages?
A: Email info@swipeloan.in asking to opt out of promotional and marketing communication.
Service messages about your account will still be sent.

## 10. Partner categories

Services are delivered together with regulated and qualified partners, each bound by
agreement to protect customer data: registered banks; NBFCs; credit assessment partners;
KYC verification partners; payment gateways; customer support vendors; technology and
hosting partners.

## 11. Terms and Conditions — structure

The full Terms and Conditions at https://kgilfintech.com/terms-and-conditions/ govern use of
www.swipeloan.in and the SWIPELOAN mobile application, and cover:

1. Introduction — SWIPELOAN is the platform operated by KGIL Fintech Solutions Private
   Limited; using the platform forms a binding contract.
2. Definitions — Applicable Laws, Platform, Business Partners (including Lending Partners),
   Minor, User, User Information and Services.
3. Acceptance of terms and general conditions — acceptance by use, legal capacity, the right
   to amend the terms, and how feedback is treated.
4. Eligibility and use of Services — account registration, one account per user, and the loan
   journey: application, eligibility check, loan offer, approval, disbursement by the Lending
   Partner and repayment; payment methods, GST on subscription plans, refunds, third-party
   software and links.
5. User obligations and responsibilities — accurate information, account security, and the
   content users may not upload or transmit.
6. General disclaimers — services provided "as is"; SWIPELOAN is a facilitator, not a lender;
   total liability capped at fees paid in the preceding six months.
7. Suspension and cancellation of User Account — grounds for suspension, how a user may
   deactivate, and obligations surviving termination.
8. Marketing and promotion — consent to promotional messages and how to opt out; DND, TRAI
   and NDNC compliance.
9. Intellectual property — ownership of platform content; permitted personal, non-commercial
   use only.
10. Indemnification — limitation of liability and the user's indemnity obligations.
11. Dispute resolution — exclusive jurisdiction of the courts at Pune, India.
12. General — entire agreement, severability, assignment, waiver, force majeure and survival.
13. Grievance redressal — Grievance Officer contact details, 24-hour acknowledgement and
    15-day resolution.

## 12. Privacy policy — structure

The full privacy policy at https://kgilfintech.com/privacy-policy/ applies to www.swipeloan.in
and the SWIPELOAN mobile application, and covers:

1. General — definitions of the Platform, Personal Information, Sensitive Personal
   Information, Users and Business Partners; the policy's status as an electronic record
   under the Information Technology Act, 2000.
2. Processing of information — processing in India, and in other jurisdictions where a
   contracted third party processes data on the company's behalf.
3. Information collected — registration details, employment information, device data, and
   the Sensitive Personal Information (financial details, Aadhaar and PAN) collected for KYC
   and eligibility; correction and amendment rights.
4. Transfer and disclosure of information — transfers to KYC partners, banking partners,
   payment partners and partner NBFCs, and disclosure required by law.
5. Processing of Information Collected — the full list of purposes for which data is used.
6. Sharing of information — sharing with Business Partners on a need-to-know basis; the
   company does not sell or rent personal information.
7. Storage and security — secure storage behind a firewall; retention periods; the fact that
   Sensitive Personal Information is not retained after it is shared with Business Partners.
8. Consent and withdrawal of permissions — how to decline or withdraw consent, and the
   consequences for service availability; opting out of promotional communication.
9. Changes to privacy policy — how changes are notified.
10. Grievance redressal — Grievance Officer contact details and resolution timelines under
    the Information Technology Act, 2000.
